label: Rational number
definition: A number expressible as a quotient a/b of integers where b is nonzero.

label: Ratio
definition: A multiplicative relationship between two quantities, with order and units interpreted from context.

excludes: Treating every ordered pair as a ratio

label: Proportional relationship
definition: A relationship between two quantities expressible as y = kx over a stated domain for a constant k.

label: Fraction notation
definition: The written form a/b. Context determines whether it expresses a number, quotient, ratio, rate, operator, or another related meaning.

label: Paired-quantity table
definition: A table aligning values of two varying quantities. It may represent either a proportional or non-proportional relationship.

label: Number line
definition: A spatial representation in which positions on an oriented line correspond to numbers and their order and distance relationships.

label: Fraction equivalence invariance
definition: Multiplying or dividing a fraction's numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number preserves the represented rational number.

label: Interpret fraction notation
definition: Interpret what a fraction-form expression denotes in a stated context without assuming that the notation has only one meaning.
capability_statement: Given a/b in a bounded context, identify the represented quantity and explain its meaning as a quotient, magnitude, equal-part relationship, ratio, or rate as appropriate.

excludes: Operating on fractions as a separate procedure

label: Compute a quotient
definition: Determine the result of division for a bounded class of numerical quantities while respecting stated precision and units.
capability_statement: Given two numerical quantities and a nonzero divisor, determine their quotient to the precision appropriate to the stated task, preserving or deriving units when relevant.

excludes: Selecting division as the appropriate model

label: Locate a rational number on a number line
definition: Place a point at the magnitude represented by a rational number on a suitably scaled number line.
capability_statement: Given a rational number and a suitably partitioned number line, locate the corresponding point and explain how the scale determines its position.

label: Compare nonnegative rational magnitudes
definition: Determine the order of two nonnegative rational numbers and justify the comparison using an admissible method.
capability_statement: Given two nonnegative rational numbers in specified representations, determine their order and justify the conclusion using a benchmark, common representation, or magnitude model.

label: Interpret a ratio
definition: State the multiplicative comparison or composed measure represented by a ratio, including the meaning of order and units.
capability_statement: Given two quantities in context, state and explain the multiplicative comparison or composed measure expressed by their ratio, including the meaning of its order and units.

label: Construct an equivalent ratio
definition: Produce another ratio that preserves the same multiplicative relationship and justify the equivalence.
capability_statement: Given a ratio, construct another ratio expressing the same multiplicative relationship and justify why the relationship is preserved.

label: Determine a unit rate
definition: Determine and interpret the amount of one quantity corresponding to one unit of another quantity.
capability_statement: Given a numerical ratio with a nonzero second quantity, determine and interpret the amount corresponding to one unit of that quantity, including appropriate units.

label: Identify a proportional relationship
definition: Determine whether two varying quantities exhibit a proportional relationship over a stated dataset or domain.
capability_statement: Given information about two varying quantities, determine whether a proportional relationship holds over the stated data or domain and justify the determination.

label: Determine a missing proportional value
definition: Find an unknown corresponding value in a proportional relationship using a valid method and state the reasoning.
capability_statement: Given a proportional relationship and sufficient known values, determine an unknown corresponding value and state the reasoning used.

label: Justify multiplicative reasoning
definition: Support a multiplicative conclusion by selecting relevant quantities, representations, definitions, or invariants and explaining why the conclusion follows; calculation alone is insufficient.
capability_statement: Given a multiplicative conclusion, select relevant quantities, representations, definitions, or invariants and explain why the conclusion follows rather than presenting calculation alone.

label: Proportional reasoning
definition: A navigation-level grouping for interpreting ratios, recognizing proportionality, determining values, and justifying multiplicative conclusions. Membership does not by itself define mastery or sequence.
